paragraphs: Niche Technology sells NicheRMS365, a records management system for police agencies, which use it to share information and eliminate siloed systems. The company says the system captures every aspect of policing from the front line to the courtroom. It describes the product as designed for multi-agency use and calls large projects its specialty.

Sworn officers in over 180 agencies worldwide use NicheRMS365. Recent announcements on the site include South Yorkshire Police, which plans to implement NicheRMS365 to modernize crime recording and strengthen data integrity. Durham Constabulary and Warwickshire Police have each selected the system as a platform that centralizes operational data. The Toronto Police Service chose it as its records management system. Orange County, New York won a 2025 Government Experience Award from the Center for Digital Government for its NicheRMS project.

Founded in 1992, Niche Technology is a private Canadian corporation based in Winnipeg, Manitoba, with additional offices in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom. It is wholly owned by its founders, who remain active in day-to-day operations. In the United States, NicheRMS365 is available to federal agencies through the General Services Administration Information Technology Schedule 70. It is also offered through the New York State Umbrella Contract and the Dell National Government Contract.

quote.text: The world’s most widely used RMS eliminates silos and delivers integrated functionality that captures every aspect of policing from the front line to the courtroom.
